docket_entries.description: CONTRACT/WARRANTY, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF TRINITY CAPITAL CORPORATION AS TO DEFENDANT JANUSKEVICIUS, SAULIUS INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA MOKENA AUTO BODY DOES 1-10, INCLUSIVE SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR DEC-17-2004 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  OCT-18-2004 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         DEC-02-2004

CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF TRINITY CAPITAL CORPORATION HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT JANUSKEVICIUS, SAULIUS INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA MOKENA AUTO BODY POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: PLEASE SEE TEXT, OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT $16,400.54 DAMAGES, $1,975.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $350.50 COSTS, $161.64 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $18,887.68, 1 CMC SPRAYBOOTH; 1 DUCT WORK; FLASHINGS X 2, STROM COLLOAR X2, ELECTRICAL SIRING, GAS LINE TO BURNER; 1 CONCRETE LAYOUT, WHICH EQUIPMENT COLLECTIVELY HAS A FAIR MARKET VALUE OF $10,000.00.
